answer: Proposed: agents forecasting zephyr-driven shale dust get at most 1 token per key/day, only after a customer burns 2 tokens bound to that key/day. Ledger validators require finalized burns; missing, invalid or reused proofs mean no pay. Hollow self-orders thus lose money; this does not verify forecasts or unique owners. Burns recur; servers are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Shared customers and parallel hosts cannot reuse burns. Ten self-funded keys burn 20 for at most 10 back: a net loss of at least 10 tokens/day.
